title: Translated-unit pullback preserves localized homotopy triangles
statement: Let f:Z→Y be proper between Noetherian schemes, with the recorded derived categories in one localization universe and a supplied strong monoidal structure on the recorded derived pullback F [def-pc-derived-pullback]. Let c_X(K):O_X[1]⊗K≅K[1] be the recorded comparison [def-sc-scheme-canonical-shift-unit-iso]. There exists an isomorphism e:F(O_Y[1])≅O_Z[1] such that for every distinguished triangle T₀ in K(O_Y), if T=Qh.mapTriangle(T₀) using the canonical homotopy localization, the triangle with maps F(T.mor₁), F(T.mor₂), and F(T.mor₃) followed by F(c_Y(T.obj₁)⁻¹), the supplied inverse tensorator δ_(O_Y[1],T.obj₁), e⊗id, and c_Z(F(T.obj₁)) is distinguished in D(O_Z). This lemma does not assert a coherent integer-shift structure or preservation of arbitrary derived triangles.

proof.text: Choose e and its distinguished-triangle assertion for K-flat cone triangles from [lem-sc-derived-pullback-translated-unit-kflat-cones]. Construct the degree-one comparison a(K)=F(c_Y(K) inverse) followed by δ, e tensor id and c_Z(F(K)). Naturality of c follows from the canonical tensor-shift naturality and the left unitor. Tensorator naturality and whisker_exchange then prove F(b[1])≫a(N)=a(K)≫F(b)[1]. No coherent integer-shift extension is needed.

Apply [lem-sc-kflat-localized-cone-presentation] to the given distinguished homotopy triangle T₀, obtaining a triangle isomorphism i from Qh(T₀) to a localized cone triangle of p:P→Q with P and Q K-flat.

Build Triangle.isoMk between their displayed pullback triangles, with components F(i₁),F(i₂),F(i₃). The first two squares are images under F of i.comm₁ and i.comm₂. For the third, naturality of a changes a(T.obj₁)≫F(i₁)[1] to F(i₁[1])≫a(S.obj₁); apply F to i.comm₃ and reassociate. Transport the distinguished cone image along this isomorphism by Pretriangulated.isomorphic_distinguished. This proves exactly the original statement.
